Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

5. No appointment on deputation/ foreign ser.vice shall be made from/to Central Government I an organization where the scale of pay and DA pattern in the parent cadre post and ex cadre post are dis-similar, if the basic pay in the parent cadre increased by one increment plus Dearness Allowance(s) including interim relief if any, admissible to a person in the parent cadre post exceeds the basic pay plus Dearness Allowance(s) including interim relief, if any, at the maximum of the Pay Level in the Pay
